description: This script generates new recipe scraper modules and associated test data, including updating the scraper registry.

classes.name: _TemplateReplacer
classes.description: Handles template code replacement for class name and host in scraper code.

classes.name: _InitRegistrar
classes.description: Manages updating the __init__.py file to register new scraper classes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating scraper generation and test data creation.

methods.name: _generate_scraper
methods.description: Creates a new scraper Python file based on a template.

methods.name: _generate_tests_and_data
methods.description: Generates test HTML and JSON data files for the scraper.

methods.name: _register_scraper
methods.description: Updates __init__.py to include the new scraper class.
